sources.label: Gate GUSD proxy creation and role initialization

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 25774700, the proxy implementation remained 0xc181faf98a90993bba78af4a9d5dde37d3dbadaf. Its runtime exposes blockUser(address), unblockUser(address), freeze(address,uint256), blocked(address), frozen(address), pause(), and unpause(), alongside AccessControl role checks. The no-delay upgrader can also replace the token logic. GUSD therefore has direct holder-restriction capability; this result does not rely on an inference from centralized metadata.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Ethereum GUSD is the issuer-native home token. The issuer-listed GateLayer deployment is a LayerZero OFT representation paired with an Ethereum OFTAdapter lockbox for that exact token. Reciprocal live peers and the Ethereum adapter's verified lock/release source establish the rail; GateLayer's generic network bridge being marked TBD is not evidence that this token-specific rail is absent. GateLayer implementation source, DVN configuration, and local privileged mint surfaces remain incompletely reviewed.

protocols.name: LayerZero OFT
protocols.note: Verified MyShareOFTAdapter wraps the Ethereum GUSD token; the GateLayer token exposes the OFT interface (interface version 1) and a reciprocal configured peer.

routes.reviewNote: Retains the separately reviewed Ethereum issuer-direct MINTER_ROLE path. The verified OFTAdapter escrows this existing ERC20; it does not turn home-chain primary issuance into bridge minting.

At GateLayer block 30510079 this initialized six-decimal GUSD returns endpoint 0xcb566e3b6934fa77258d68ea18e931fa75e1aaaa, endpoint ID 30389, OFT interface 0x02e49c2c/version 1, and Ethereum peer 0x843a497b06147b2c3b648bd2cace427139e313e2. That verified Ethereum MyShareOFTAdapter returns the tracked Ethereum GUSD as token(); at Ethereum block 25909655 its peer for 30389 returns this GateLayer address. The GateLayer implementation is unverified on its explorer. MINTER_ROLE membership for the known Gate EOA exists, but tested mint(address,uint256) simulations reverted; no independent local mint behavior is inferred.
